sources.description: The field position battle of the first quarter was slowly grinding away in the Jacksonville Jaguars favor as the Denver Broncos offense continued to be completely inept. On the first play of the second quarter, Trevor Lawrence fired a bullet down field for a 22-yard completion to Brian Thomas to get into field goal range […]
